retainedFailures.case: OBJECT SET ENABLED applied to a native list box
retainedFailures.finding: Unsupported 4D command target. Disabled flag reverted even with bridge stopped; timer continued. The corrected live tests use provider readiness and retained-element rejection.

An earlier compiled run reported input delivery without a header handler event or sort. An isolated two-activation probe and a freshly prepared complete compiled run pass. The cause is unresolved; no scheduler workaround or mutation retry was added.
